description: Queries with the problem ids a correct retriever should surface. Written for backend/tests/eval_rag.py, which scores Recall@k / MRR / nDCG@5 / context size / latency offline. Deliberately contains (a) exact-terminology queries, (b) PARAPHRASES with little lexical overlap, and (c) negative controls expected to return nothing - the first two prove the TF-IDF-only configuration is weak exactly where the plan says it is, the third proves it does not invent matches.
notes: A query with expected_ids [] is a NEGATIVE CONTROL: a retriever that returns anything for it is producing false positives.
kind=exact / kind=paraphrase / kind=control is recorded per query so the baseline can separate the two failure modes.
